task.description: WF-03 Step 3c security gate. Review the implementation commit on this branch (git diff origin/main..HEAD in context.worktree, non-handoff files) against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1..INV-8. First apply the scope test: this change touches only QA seed fixtures and seed shell scripts, no lib/ code, no router/migration/response shaping; state explicitly whether it is in scope. Regardless, assess: (a) SSRF posture unchanged (engine https/private-IP gate not loosened; scripts reject non-https SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL); (b) egress to third-party httpbin.org: what data leaves the tenant (path placeholders such as order/batch ids, body?) - is any tenant/PII data sent to a public third party from QA seeds, and is that acceptable for QA-only synthetic data; recommend mitigation if needed (env override exists); (c) shell injection / unsafe interpolation in the new helper and scripts (quoting, jq --arg usage, token never echoed); (d) fixtures contain no secrets. Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL (PASS also if out of scope but no concerns; list any MINOR issues); next_action 'Route to REVIEWER'.

result.scope: Out of scope for INV-1/2/3/5/6/7/8: diff is QA seed scripts, QA fixtures, one design doc; no lib/ code, router, migration, response shaping, or SQL. INV-4 (secrets) checked because scripts handle QA_AUTH_TOKEN.

invariants.INV-4: PASS - token used only in an Authorization header arg to curl; never echoed by new code; helper contains no secrets; fixtures grep clean (no secret/password/bearer/api key)

assessment.a_ssrf: PASS - no lib/ change, so engine UrlValidator https/private-IP gate unchanged. Helper rejects non-https and whitespace in SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL and empty host, before any network call. Override is seed-time operator input only; engine still validates at dispatch.
assessment.b_egress: ACCEPTABLE for QA synthetic data. Fixtures set no body_template and no headers, so no body and no Authorization header leave; only method+URL. Data leaving: rendered path placeholders (application_id, review_id, shipment_id, order_id, batch_ref, deviation_id) plus source IP to httpbin.org/anything, which echoes and may be logged by the third party. Must not use real customer/PII identifiers in QA scenarios; MINOR: state this in scripts/README.md. Mitigation already present: SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL override to a self-hosted echo endpoint; recommend that for any QA env holding non-synthetic data. Production must never be seeded with these fixtures.
assessment.c_shell: PASS - all expansions quoted; jq uses --arg for old/new base (no interpolation into filter); payload passed via printf %s (no echo/eval); no eval, no set -x; base URL validated. Minor robustness only: sed/sort -V/head usage is fine.
assessment.d_fixtures: PASS - no secrets; only public https URLs, template placeholders, method, timeout.

minor_issues: Document in scripts/README.md that httpbin.org receives rendered path IDs and QA data must be synthetic (non-blocking).
Path placeholder values are not URL-encoded by fixture; engine renderer concern, out of scope.
